SELECT

FROM "chicago_crime"."Community_Area" ca
JOIN "chicago_crime"."Crime" c ON ca."community_area_no" = c."community_area_no"

SELECT MAX(
    to_timestamp(
        regexp_replace(bh."closing_time", '^([0-9]+)([AP]M)$', '\1:00 \2'),
        'HH12:MI PM'
    )::time -
    to_timestamp(
        regexp_replace(bh."opening_time", '^([0-9]+)([AP]M)$', '\1:00 \2'),
        'HH12:MI PM'
    )::time
) AS longest_monday_duration
FROM "Business_Hours" bh
JOIN "Days" d ON bh."day_id" = d."day_id"
JOIN "Business_Categories" bc ON bh."business_id" = bc."business_id"
JOIN "Categories" c ON bc."category_id" = c."category_id"
WHERE d."day_of_week" = 'Monday'
  AND c."category_name" = 'Shopping'

WITH uk_actors AS (

  FROM "movies2actors"
  JOIN "movies" ON "movies2actors"."movieid" = "movies"."movieid"
  WHERE "movies"."country" = 'UK'
),
uk_actor_rated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "movies2actors"."actorid"
  FROM "movies2actors"
  JOIN "movies" ON "movies2actors"."movieid" = "movies"."movieid"
  JOIN "u2base" ON "u2base"."movieid" = "movies"."movieid"
  WHERE "movies"."country" = 'UK' AND CAST("u2base"."rating" AS numeric) >= 3
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
       ELSE round(100.0 * rated / total, 2)
  END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uk_actors) AS total,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uk_actor_rated) AS rated
) sub

WITH uk_actors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "movies2actors"."actorid"
  FROM "movies2actors"
  JOIN "movies" ON "movies2actors"."movieid" = "movies"."movieid"
  WHERE "movies"."country" = 'UK'
),
rated_actors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "ma"."actorid"
  FROM "movies2actors" "ma"
  JOIN "u2base" ON "u2base"."movieid" = "ma"."movieid"
  WHERE CAST("u2base"."rating" AS numeric) >= 3
    AND "ma"."actorid" IN (SELECT "actorid" FROM uk_actors)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN total = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE round(100.0 * rated / total, 2)
       END AS percentage
FROM (
  SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM uk_actors) AS total,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rated_actors) AS rated
) sub

)

            ELSE round(100.0 * rated / total, 2)
